mood: Landscape fantasy collage on cream paper: a large white pointed hat, jeweled crown and furry ape muzzle with round eyes and pink mouth overlap cobalt surf. Across open paper, a smaller orchid-and-bee cluster rests on detached wave shelves. A dotted pink face-ruff nestles against an angled broom; purple roots, veined greens, twisted cord and a crowned bulb weave through the fragments. Red strokes flank a floral disk.

Long strand-rendered white fur, smooth modeled muzzles and densely dotted pink petals.
Fuzzy striped bee bodies, fine legs and translucent amber-veined wings.
lighting: Soft, even illustrated luminosity; cream remains warm, with restrained local occlusion beneath brim, fur and petals rather than cinematic beams.
